rewrites.//: Everything else is the SPA. The exclusions are real files in public/ or dist/ that MUST be served as themselves — the Android app depends on three of them: .well-known/assetlinks.json is what proves the app owns this domain (served as HTML, the app shows a Chrome URL bar), manifest.webmanifest is what Bubblewrap reads to build the shell, and sw.js has to be JavaScript or registration fails.

headers.//: The browser only picks up a new service worker when it re-fetches this file. Vercel caches static assets hard by default, which would delay every future SW change by up to 24h.
Digital Asset Links must be application/json or Android's verifier rejects it.
